description: Interface definition for the Realm Engine
purpose: Manages the nine fixed cosmological realms, player attunement, realm shifts, and thin veil locations

inputs.name: player_state
inputs.description: Current player state including realm attunement values

inputs.name: location
inputs.description: Current player location to check for thin veil sites

inputs.name: cosmic_pattern_snapshot
inputs.description: CosmicPatternSnapshot required by ASH generation contract.

inputs.name: diagnostic_envelope
inputs.description: DiagnosticEnvelope required by ASH generation contract.

inputs.name: generation_plan
inputs.description: GenerationPlan required by ASH generation contract.

outputs.name: active_realm
outputs.description: The realm the player currently resonates with

outputs.name: realm_overlay
outputs.description: Realm-specific overlay data for the current location

outputs.name: realm_transition_resolution
outputs.description: RealmTransitionResolution emitted under ASH generation contract.

outputs.name: worldstate_delta_packet
outputs.description: WorldstateDeltaPacket emitted under ASH generation contract.

outputs.name: realm_boundary_profile_record
outputs.description: RealmBoundaryProfileRecord emitted under ASH generation contract.

methods.name: get_realm_attunement
methods.description: Return player attunement level for a specific realm

methods.name: check_realm_shift_eligible
methods.description: Check if a player can shift to a target realm at their current location

methods.name: execute_realm_shift
methods.description: Shift a player to a target realm

methods.name: add_attunement
methods.description: Add realm attunement to a player for a specific realm

methods.name: resolve_realm_transition
methods.description: Resolve realm transition permissions from ASH provenance and boundary profile.

invariants: Realms are fixed cosmological states and cannot be created or destroyed
Players always have access to the Physical Realm
Realm shift requires both attunement threshold and thin veil location
CosmicPatternSnapshot and DiagnosticEnvelope provenance is required for meaningful generation.
GenerationPlan is required before any materialized output.
source_ash_refs, diagnostic_ref, and generation_plan_ref must remain traceable.

ash_alignment_contract.math_basis: F2^9 full-state ASH vector with exactly 16 canonical codewords and x' = x XOR c transitions
ash_alignment_contract.truth_boundary: GenerationPlan may guide materialization; downstream engines and adapters must not author ASH truth or YWE domain truth.
